pages.text: Your speed is a weapon. A blow struck while running, or at the end of a leap, lands harder than one from standing still. $(br2)A sprinting strike hits a little harder. A leaping strike hits much harder.
pages.title: Speed as a Weapon

pages.text: Use this in a hunt, not to bully. A warrior who charges blindly into a badger will not live to brag about it.
